# IMPERIA COLD WAR - OPEC 1970 (the oil price explained, monthly steps of resolutions, joint embargoes, cuts, quotas, the Fund).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_OPEC_generator/build.py - do not edit by hand.

# Any scope. Values of the MARKET tab: spot, OPEC level, embargo shortage, consumer prices, the price in dollars of the day and of 1970, petrodollar factor.
COLDWAR_OPEC_market_values = {
	# the chain of the price (read only)
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_spot = 75 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.imp_global_oil_price }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_spot = global.imp_global_oil_price }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_level = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_level = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_emb = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_emb = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_cpi = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_cpi }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_cpi = global.mdcw_cw_cpi }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_real = global.cwop_mk_spot }
	divide_variable = { global.cwop_mk_real = 75 }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_mk_real = global.cwop_mk_level }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_mk_real = global.cwop_mk_emb }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_price = global.cwop_mk_real }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_mk_price = 1.8 }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_mk_price = global.cwop_mk_cpi }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_usd70 = global.cwop_mk_real }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_mk_usd70 = 1.8 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_petro = global.cwop_mk_real }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwop_mk_petro min = 0 max = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_share = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_cut = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_share = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share }
		multiply_variable = { global.cwop_mk_share = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_cut = global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share }
		multiply_variable = { global.cwop_mk_cut = 100 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_embpct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_pct }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_mk_embpct = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_pct }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_forecast = yes
}

# Any scope. The OPEC level of next month: Cold War agreements and cuts (25 % line), drift back to 1, conservation above 3, and the OPEC resolutions in force.
COLDWAR_OPEC_forecast = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_save = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_res = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_sh = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_ct = global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_target = cwop_t_sh }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_fc_target = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_fc_target = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_sh > 0.2499 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_sh > cwop_t_ct } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_mk_level < global.cwop_fc_target } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_t_sh }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0.015 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = cwop_t_x }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_mk_spot > 100 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = global.cwop_mk_spot }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = -100 }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 75 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_t_sh }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 1 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = cwop_t_x }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_ct > 0.2499 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_ct > cwop_t_sh } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_t_ct }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0.5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_y = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwop_t_y = cwop_t_x }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_mk_level > cwop_t_y } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = cwop_t_ct }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = -0.015 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = cwop_t_x }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 4 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 5 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_mk_level > 1.001 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 0.995 }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_mk_level < 0.999 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 1.005 }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 6 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 7 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_mk_level > 3 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 0.996 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_save = 1 }
	}
	# OPEC resolutions in force
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage < global.cwop_cut_cap } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_cutters
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_x min = 0 max = 1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0.05 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = cwop_t_x }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_res = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_quota
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_x min = 0 max = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_x > 0.2499 } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 1.01 }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_res = 2 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_b4_months > 0 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 0.97 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_res = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_a8_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio < global.cwop_a8_lo } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 1.02 }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_res = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio > global.cwop_a8_hi } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 0.98 }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_res = 4 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_freeze }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_why = 8 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_pct = cwop_t_f }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_fc_pct = -1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_fc_pct = 100 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_next = global.cwop_mk_level }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_fc_next = cwop_t_f }
	# three months for the Secretary General
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f3 = cwop_t_f }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f3 = cwop_t_f }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_f3 = cwop_t_f }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_next3 = global.cwop_mk_level }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_fc_next3 = cwop_t_f3 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_fc_pct > 0.05 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_dir = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_fc_pct < -0.05 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_dir = 3 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwop_fc_dir = 2 }
	}
}

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_hist20 > global.cwop_hmax } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_hmax = global.cwop_hist20 }

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_hist21 > global.cwop_hmax } }

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_hist22 > global.cwop_hmax } }

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_hist23 > global.cwop_hmax } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_hmax = global.cwop_hist23 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_hist24 > global.cwop_hmax } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_hmax = global.cwop_hist24 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_tier1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_tier2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_tier3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_tier4 = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_tier1 = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_tier2 = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 3 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_tier3 = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 4 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwop_tier4 = 1 }
		}
	}
	# an Arab-Israeli war keeps the Arab oil ministers ready for a year (October 1973 to March 1974)
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = ISR
			ISR = { any_enemy_country = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes } } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_arab_war days = 365 value = 1 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Monthly steps of the OPEC resolutions in force.
COLDWAR_OPEC_monthly_price = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_lv = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
	# E2: the oil weapon cuts a further 5 % each month up to its ceiling
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage < global.cwop_cut_cap } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_cutters
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_x min = 0 max = 1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0.05 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = cwop_t_x }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_cut_values = yes
	}
	# B2: quotas hold the line while the quota holders keep 25 % of world exports
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_quota_end } } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_end_quotas = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_quota
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } }
			}
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwop_t_x min = 0 max = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_x > 0.2499 } }
				multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 1.01 }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_quota_check = yes
		}
	}
	# B4: the market-share strategy lets the price fall for six months
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_b4_months > 0 } }
		multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 0.97 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_b4_months = -1 }
	}
	# A8: the reference price pulls the real price into its band (only while quotas run)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_a8_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end = 0 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_a8_target = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio < global.cwop_a8_lo } }
			multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 1.02 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio > global.cwop_a8_hi } }
			multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 0.98 }
		}
	}
	# A5: the freeze holds the level (the Cold War update is reset to the frozen value by a COLDWAR line)
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_freeze }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = global.cwop_freeze_level }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level min = 0.5 max = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = cwop_t_lv } } }
		mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = yes
		imp_update_oil_price_display = yes
	}
	# C1: the second step of participation after three years
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_watch
		if = { limit = { exists = yes check_variable = { cwop_c1_day > 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwop_c1_day } } }
			add_to_variable = { cwop_m_EX = 0.04 }
			set_variable = { cwop_c1_day = 0 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
		}
	}
	# E8 and the Fund: monthly payments
	COLDWAR_OPEC_payments = yes
}

# Any scope. 1 January: the currency basket (A7).
COLDWAR_OPEC_yearly = {
	# A7: the currency basket follows US consumer prices every 1 January (after 5 % inflation)
	if = {
		limit = { any_of_scopes = { array = global.cwop_members has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_basket }
			check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi > global.cwop_a7_next } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_basket }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
				}
			}
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0.1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = cwop_t_x }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_a7_next = global.mdcw_cw_cpi }
		multiply_variable = { global.cwop_a7_next = 1.05 }
		mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = yes
		imp_update_oil_price_display = yes
	}
}

# Sender scope, PREV = target. One bilateral oil embargo of the Cold War system (arrays, opinions); pressure and world shortage are recounted once after the batch.
COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { mdcw_cw_can_embargo_prev = yes
			NOT = { tag = PREV } }
		add_to_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_targets value = PREV }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out = 1 }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo }
		PREV = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo }
			add_to_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources value = PREV }
			set_country_flag = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_happened
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo }
		}
	}
}

# Sender scope, PREV = target. Lifts exactly this bilateral embargo.
COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_end = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_targets value = PREV } }
		remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo }
		PREV = { remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo } }
		remove_from_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_targets value = PREV }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out min = 0 max = 99 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out < 1 } }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_lost_sales = 0 }
		}
		PREV = { remove_from_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources value = PREV } }
	}
}

# Any scope. After a batch of embargo changes: pressure on every target and the world shortage once (Cold War formulas).
COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total > 0 } } }
		imp_calculate_oil_producers = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes
	every_country = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources^num > 0 } } mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_pressure = yes }
	every_country = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_in > 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources^num > 0 } } } mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_pressure = yes }
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_world = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_world_situation = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwop_n_emb = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_emb = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_emb = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_emb = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_n_emb = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_n_emb = 0 } }
		clear_array = global.cwop_noleak
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_no_leaks
		every_country = { limit = { check_variable = { cwop_l_EX < 0 } } set_variable = { cwop_l_EX = 0 } COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. Every source of joint embargo 1 embargoes every target of it.
COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_start_all = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_e1_src
		if = { limit = { exists = yes }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_e1_tg
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_start = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (a source). Ends its part in joint embargo 1.
COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end_source = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_e1_tg
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_end = yes } }
	}
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e1_src = THIS }
}

# Any scope. Joint embargo 1 ends (duration, peace, lifting by everybody).
COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_e1_src
		if = { limit = { exists = yes }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_e1_tg
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_end = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 57 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_res = 9 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_target = global.cwop_e1_target }
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q9_item = cwop_t_eitem }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q9_res = cwop_t_eres }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q9_target = cwop_t_etarget }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q9_val = cwop_t_eval }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev9_busy } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev9_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.9 }
		}
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_e1_src
	clear_array = global.cwop_e1_tg
	set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_peace = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_route = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_since = 0 }
}

# Any scope. Monthly: joint embargo 1 ends at its date, with peace (option) or when no source is left.
COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_tick = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_clean = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_e1_end } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_peace = 1 }
			var:global.cwop_e1_target = { NOT = { any_enemy_country = { OR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes } } } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_src^num < 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Vanished countries leave joint embargo 1.
COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_clean = {
	clear_temp_array = cwop_t_g
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_e1_tg
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } } add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_g = THIS } }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_e1_src
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } } add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_g = THIS } }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_g
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e1_tg = THIS }
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e1_src = THIS }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_e1_target = { exists = yes } } }
		clear_array = global.cwop_e1_src
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_end > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_e4_end } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_end = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_peace = 1 }
			var:global.cwop_e4_target = { NOT = { any_enemy_country = { OR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes } } } } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_end = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_src^num < 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_end = yes
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Vanished countries leave joint embargo 4.
COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_clean = {
	clear_temp_array = cwop_t_g
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_e4_tg
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } } add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_g = THIS } }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_e4_src
		if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } } add_to_temp_array = { cwop_t_g = THIS } }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwop_t_g
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e4_tg = THIS }
		remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e4_src = THIS }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_e4_target = { exists = yes } } }
		clear_array = global.cwop_e4_src
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_rec: a free joint embargo record (0 = four are running).
COLDWAR_OPEC_find_record = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 4 }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwop_t_rec: the joint embargo whose main target is global.cwop_ctx_target.
COLDWAR_OPEC_record_of_target = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 4 }
	}
}

# Any scope. E1: every bound member embargoes the target (and its subjects or alliance); tension +3 once.
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E1 = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_record_of_target = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec > 0 } }
		# the target is already under a joint embargo: the new members join it
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 1 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e1_src value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e1_src = THIS } }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_start_all = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 2 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e2_src value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e2_src = THIS } }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e2_start_all = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 3 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e3_src value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e3_src = THIS } }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e3_start_all = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 4 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e4_src value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e4_src = THIS } }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_start_all = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_find_record = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 1 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_since = global.num_days }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_route = global.cwop_ctx_route }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end = 90 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 2 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end = 180 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 3 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end = 365 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_end = 0 }
			}
			# the embargo ends by itself when the target stops fighting a member or an Arab state (Kuwait 1973: until Israel withdraws)
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_peace = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { any_enemy_country = { OR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes } } } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e1_peace = 1 }
			}
			clear_array = global.cwop_e1_src
			clear_array = global.cwop_e1_tg
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e1_src = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_e1_tg = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = 2 } }
				every_country = { limit = { is_subject_of = var:global.cwop_ctx_target } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e1_tg = THIS } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = 3 } }
				var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { every_country = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = PREV NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e1_tg = THIS } } }
			}
			# members and the OAPEC are never targets of their own embargo
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e1_tg = THIS }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_start_all = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 2 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_since = global.num_days }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_route = global.cwop_ctx_route }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e2_end = 90 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 2 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e2_end = 180 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 3 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e2_end = 365 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_end = 0 }
			}
			# the embargo ends by itself when the target stops fighting a member or an Arab state (Kuwait 1973: until Israel withdraws)
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_peace = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { any_enemy_country = { OR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes } } } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e2_peace = 1 }
			}
			clear_array = global.cwop_e2_src
			clear_array = global.cwop_e2_tg
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e2_src = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_e2_tg = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = 2 } }
				every_country = { limit = { is_subject_of = var:global.cwop_ctx_target } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e2_tg = THIS } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = 3 } }
				var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { every_country = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = PREV NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e2_tg = THIS } } }
			}
			# members and the OAPEC are never targets of their own embargo
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e2_tg = THIS }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e2_start_all = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 3 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_since = global.num_days }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_route = global.cwop_ctx_route }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e3_end = 90 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 2 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e3_end = 180 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 3 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e3_end = 365 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_end = 0 }
			}
			# the embargo ends by itself when the target stops fighting a member or an Arab state (Kuwait 1973: until Israel withdraws)
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_peace = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { any_enemy_country = { OR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes } } } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e3_peace = 1 }
			}
			clear_array = global.cwop_e3_src
			clear_array = global.cwop_e3_tg
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e3_src = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_e3_tg = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = 2 } }
				every_country = { limit = { is_subject_of = var:global.cwop_ctx_target } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e3_tg = THIS } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = 3 } }
				var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { every_country = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = PREV NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e3_tg = THIS } } }
			}
			# members and the OAPEC are never targets of their own embargo
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e3_tg = THIS }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e3_start_all = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 4 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_since = global.num_days }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_route = global.cwop_ctx_route }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 1 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e4_end = 90 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 2 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e4_end = 180 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 3 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwop_e4_end = 365 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_end = 0 }
			}
			# the embargo ends by itself when the target stops fighting a member or an Arab state (Kuwait 1973: until Israel withdraws)
			set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_peace = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { any_enemy_country = { OR = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = yes } } } }
				set_variable = { global.cwop_e4_peace = 1 }
			}
			clear_array = global.cwop_e4_src
			clear_array = global.cwop_e4_tg
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e4_src = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_e4_tg = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = 2 } }
				every_country = { limit = { is_subject_of = var:global.cwop_ctx_target } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e4_tg = THIS } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt2 = 3 } }
				var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { every_country = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = PREV NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e4_tg = THIS } } }
			}
			# members and the OAPEC are never targets of their own embargo
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_ctx_part
				remove_from_array = { global.cwop_e4_tg = THIS }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_start_all = yes
		}
	}
	# four joint embargoes run already: the resolution finds no record and does nothing
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec > 0 } }
		var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { set_variable = { cwop_class = 4 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_embargo } }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 3 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q8_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q8_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q8_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q8_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev8_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev8_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.8 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. E4: a running joint embargo is extended to a new target (Algiers 1973).
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E4 = {
	# the newest running joint embargo takes the new target with the same sources
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_e1_tg = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e1_src value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e1_src = THIS } }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_start_all = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 2 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_e2_tg = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e2_src value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e2_src = THIS } }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e2_start_all = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 3 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_e3_tg = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e3_src value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e3_src = THIS } }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e3_start_all = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 4 } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwop_e4_tg = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e4_src value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_e4_src = THIS } }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_start_all = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec > 0 } }
		var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { set_variable = { cwop_class = 4 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_embargo } }
		}
		COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 1 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q8_item = cwop_t_eitem }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q8_res = cwop_t_eres }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q8_target = cwop_t_etarget }
			set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
			add_to_array = { cwop_q8_val = cwop_t_eval }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev8_busy } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev8_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.8 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. E7: the For-voters lift their embargo on the target; who did not agree keeps his (Vienna 1974: Syria and Libya). With no joint embargo left the cuts end too.
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E7 = {
	COLDWAR_OPEC_record_of_target = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 1 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e1_src value = THIS } } COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end_source = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_src^num < 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 2 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e2_src value = THIS } } COLDWAR_OPEC_e2_end_source = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_src^num < 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e2_end = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 3 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e3_src value = THIS } } COLDWAR_OPEC_e3_end_source = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_src^num < 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e3_end = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_rec = 4 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e4_src value = THIS } } COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_end_source = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_src^num < 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_end = yes
		}
	}
	# lifted by the For-voters: bilateral embargoes of the For-voters on the target end too
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_end = yes } }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_lifted } }
	}
	var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { set_variable = { cwop_class = 3 } }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_any_joint_embargo = yes } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_end_cuts = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -1 }
	mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
}

# Any scope. The cutters lose 1 % of oil export income for every 1 % of cut.
COLDWAR_OPEC_cut_values = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_ex = global.cwop_cut_stage }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwop_cut_ex = -0.01 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_cutters
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } set_variable = { cwop_c_EX = global.cwop_cut_ex } COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. E2: the bound members cut their output 5 % at once and 5 % more each month up to the ceiling (10, 15 or 25 %).
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E2 = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_cutters value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwop_cutters = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage = 5 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_since = global.num_days }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_cap = global.cwop_ctx_opt1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_cap < 10 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_cap = 25 }
	}
	# the first step at once (5 % below the level of the month before)
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0.05 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = cwop_t_x }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level min = 0.5 max = 12 }
	mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = yes
	imp_update_oil_price_display = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_cut_values = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eitem = global.cwop_ctx_item }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q8_item = cwop_t_eitem }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eres = global.cwop_ctx_res }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q8_res = cwop_t_eres }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_etarget = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q8_target = cwop_t_etarget }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_eval = 0 }
		add_to_array = { cwop_q8_val = cwop_t_eval }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev8_busy } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_ev8_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OPEC.8 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The cuts end.
COLDWAR_OPEC_end_cuts = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_cutters
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } set_variable = { cwop_c_EX = 0 } COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_cutters
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_cap = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_ex = 0 }
}

# Any scope. E5: the ban on indirect supply closes the leaks (embargo pressure x 1.25 by a COLDWAR line in the Cold War formula) while embargoes run.
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E5 = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_no_leaks
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwop_noleak = THIS } set_variable = { cwop_l_EX = -0.05 } COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes }
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
}

# Any scope. E6: the cut falls by two steps; the group thanks the members (18 Nov and 25 Dec 1973).
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E6 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_cutters
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = -0.1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwop_t_x = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = cwop_t_x }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage = -10 }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_cut_cap = global.cwop_cut_stage }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage < 1 } }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_end_cuts = yes
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_OPEC_cut_values = yes
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level min = 0.5 max = 12 }
		mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = yes
		imp_update_oil_price_display = yes
	}
	# goodwill of the group
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 1 } }
		every_country = { limit = { OR = { original_tag = FRA original_tag = GER original_tag = ITA original_tag = BEL original_tag = HOL original_tag = LUX COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_class = 4 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_ctx_part PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_goodwill } } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_country = { limit = { COLDWAR_OPEC_net_importer = yes NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_class = 4 } } NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_ctx_part PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_goodwill } } }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -1 }
	mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
}

# Any scope. E3: the class of a consumer (most favoured and preferential: exempt by the bound members and spared the world shortage; embargoed: a joint embargo).
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E3 = {
	var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { set_variable = { cwop_class = global.cwop_ctx_opt1 } COLDWAR_OPEC_watch = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 2 } } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_ctx_part
			var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { PREV = { COLDWAR_OPEC_pair_end = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_exempt_targets value = PREV } } } add_to_array = { mdcw_cw_oil_exempt_targets = PREV } } } }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_ctx_part var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_favoured } } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E1 = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
}

# Any scope. E8: resume pumping and pay the front state instead (Khartoum, 1 Sep 1967).
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_E8 = {
	# the For-voters end their part in every joint embargo and in the cuts
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e1_src value = THIS } }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_end_source = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e2_src value = THIS } }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_e2_end_source = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e3_src value = THIS } }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_e3_end_source = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_e4_src value = THIS } }
				COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_end_source = yes
			}
			remove_from_array = { global.cwop_cutters = THIS }
			set_variable = { cwop_c_EX = 0 }
			COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cutters^num < 1 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_end_cuts = yes
	}
	# three years of payments to the front state
	set_variable = { global.cwop_k_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_k_end = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_k_end = 1095 }
	clear_array = global.cwop_k_payers
	for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_ctx_part add_to_array = { global.cwop_k_payers = THIS } }
	var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_t_E8 days = 1095 } }
	for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_ctx_part var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_khartoum } } }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_recount = yes
}

# Any scope. Monthly payments of the Khartoum formula and the OPEC Fund; programmes end after 730 days.
COLDWAR_OPEC_payments = {
	# E8: 0.2 % of GDP a year, paid monthly, to the front state
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_k_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_k_end } }
					NOT = { var:global.cwop_k_target = { exists = yes } }
			} }
			set_variable = { global.cwop_k_target = 0 }
			clear_array = global.cwop_k_payers
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwop_k_payers
				if = { limit = { exists = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.000167 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					var:global.cwop_k_target = { modify_treasury_effect = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# the OPEC Fund: 0.1 % of GDP a year, paid monthly, while programmes run
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_f1_target > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_f2_target > 0 } } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwop_fund_payers
			if = { limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0000833 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_f1_target > 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_f1_end } }
				NOT = { var:global.cwop_f1_target = { exists = yes } }
		} }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwop_f1_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwop_f1_target = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_fund_recipient } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_f1_target = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_f2_target > 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwop_f2_end } }
				NOT = { var:global.cwop_f2_target = { exists = yes } }
		} }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwop_f2_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwop_f2_target = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_fund_recipient } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_f2_target = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Monthly: joint embargoes and cuts.
COLDWAR_OPEC_embargo_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e1_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e2_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e3_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_e4_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_cutters^num < 1 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_cut_stage > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_end_cuts = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. B2: production ceiling with quotas for 365 days (renewed: one more year).
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_B2 = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_ctx_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_quota value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { global.cwop_quota = THIS }
			set_variable = { cwop_q_EX = -0.08 }
			set_variable = { cwop_pq = 0 }
			clear_array = cwop_qlob
			clear_array = cwop_qpay
			clear_array = cwop_qprs
			COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end = 365 }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_overprod
}

# Any scope. The quotas end (after their year, or by the market-share strategy B4).
COLDWAR_OPEC_end_quotas = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_quota
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } set_variable = { cwop_q_EX = 0 } set_variable = { cwop_pq = 0 } COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwop_quota
	clear_array = global.cwop_overprod
	set_variable = { global.cwop_quota_end = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_a8_target = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_swing > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_end_swing = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (player). Leaves its quota (no vote needed; its share no longer counts).
COLDWAR_OPEC_leave_quota = {
	remove_from_array = { global.cwop_quota = THIS }
	set_variable = { cwop_q_EX = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_swing = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_OPEC_end_swing = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. B3: the requester balances the market as swing producer (oil income -15 %); the other quota holders gain 5 %.
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_B3 = {
	set_variable = { global.cwop_swing = global.cwop_ctx_by }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwop_quota
		if = { limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_swing = THIS.id } }
				set_variable = { cwop_s_EX = -0.15 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwop_s_EX = 0.05 }
			}
			COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The swing producer stops (by its click, the end of the quotas or the loss of the country).
COLDWAR_OPEC_end_swing = {
	every_country = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_s_EX = 0 } } } set_variable = { cwop_s_EX = 0 } COLDWAR_OPEC_refresh_country = yes }
	set_variable = { global.cwop_swing = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwop_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. F1: a programme of the OPEC Fund for a country outside OPEC (730 days).
COLDWAR_OPEC_apply_F1 = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fk = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_f1_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_fk = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fk = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwop_f2_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwop_t_fk = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_fk = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_fk = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_f1_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_f1_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_f1_end = 730 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_fk = 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_f2_target = global.cwop_ctx_target }
		set_variable = { global.cwop_f2_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwop_f2_end = 730 }
	}
	# two programmes run already: the resolution finds no place and does nothing
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwop_t_fk > 0 } }
		var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_OPEC_t_F1 days = 730 } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_fund_recipient }
		for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.cwop_fund_payers var:global.cwop_ctx_target = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OPEC_op_fund } } }
	}
}

# Country scope. Hook in the Cold War recount of received programmes (mdcw_cw_effects, COLDWAR line).
COLDWAR_OPEC_cw_receiver = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_fund_recipient }
		# a programme of the OPEC Fund counts as received assistance: construction +5 % (x1.25 for a non-aligned recipient)
		set_temp_variable = { cwop_t_v = 0.05 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwop_t_v = 1.25 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = cwop_t_v }
	}
}
